{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out refunded orders and QA orders
# QA orders are marked by revenue = '999999.99'
# Refunded orders are status == 'refunded'
# Also remove rows with customer_age == -1 (missing data)

# Convert revenue to float after stripping commas
# But only after filtering, to avoid parsing the QA values

# First, filter out QA orders and refunded orders
valid_df = df[~(df['revenue'] == '999999.99')]
valid_df = valid_df[valid_df['status'] == 'completed']
valid_df = valid_df[valid_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Now convert revenue to float
valid_df['revenue'] = valid_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the final size
print(f'Final number of completed, non-QA, non-refunded, non-missing-age orders: {len(valid_df)}')

# Now compute conversion rates by channel
# Convert is 1 if completed checkout
conversion_rates = valid_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('Conversion rates by channel:')
print(conversion_rates)

# Compute difference (email minus paid_search)
email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
paid_search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {difference}')"}
